# ZXing-js (vendor)

- Package: [@zxing/library](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/library) 0.23.0
- File: official `umd/index.min.js` (lazy-loaded by the app when the barcode scanner opens)
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE)
- Upstream: https://github.com/zxing-js/library

Used only as a fallback decoder for UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-13, and EAN-8 on browsers without `BarcodeDetector` (notably iPhone Safari).
